name: Jachin
overview: Jachin was a male member of the tribe of Simeon, uniquely identified as a son of Simeon. He appears in the biblical record as part of the list of sons of Israel who journeyed to Egypt, marking him as one of the early descendants who entered Egypt during the patriarchal period. His descendants, the Jachinites, are also noted in the census of the tribe of Simeon.
namesAndTitles: The name Jachin means 'he establishes,' reflecting a sense of stability or foundation. Another name associated with this lineage is Jarib, meaning 'YHWH contends,' which appears in a related genealogical context but is distinct from Jachin himself.
familyAndRelationships: Scripture explicitly records Jachin as a son of Simeon, establishing his place within the family of Israel. No additional familial relationships are detailed beyond this connection.
scriptureSignificance: Jachin's significance lies in his role as a foundational figure within the tribe of Simeon, contributing to the growth of Israel in Egypt. His inclusion in the genealogies emphasizes God's providential preservation of the covenant people through successive generations. The mention of the Jachinites in the census further highlights the continuation of his lineage within the broader narrative of Israel's formation.
